one_liner: SendGrid has a broad REST v3 API using API-key auth, but new accounts only get a 60-day, 100/day trial before a paid plan is needed; MCP status is unverified from the pages (community server claimed).
auth_notes: Users create an API key in Settings > API Keys and send it as a Bearer token. No OAuth for third-party developers appears in the pages.
access_notes: New accounts get a 60-day timed trial (100 emails/day via API/SMTP, no credit card). After it ends, API email send stops unless a paid Email API plan is chosen. Some features (Subusers) need Pro or Premier.
blocker_notes: API works during the 60-day trial, but continued sending needs a paid plan. Each user must create and paste their own API key (no OAuth).

evidence.quote: The SendGrid connector uses a SendGrid API key to ingest data into Azure Databricks.
Click **Create & View**, then copy the generated key. SendGrid shows the key value only once.
users will be given a 60 day timed free trial plan.
**Send up to 100 email messages via web API or SMTP per day**
After the 60 day trial period, email send via any web API or SMTP integration for the account will stop unless an appropriate "Email API" plan is chosen
